system.description:
You may make a [Normal Move] up to your [Speed] Sq. In addition, after the end of the Main Process, you may make a [Safe Move] up to [SR] Sq. You may only use this skill when you have the [Mythic] tag.

A special skill that orders the phantom beast that is being summoned as a follower to assist in movement. There are various means of assistance depending on the phantom beast, such as straddling the back or having acceleration magic cast on it.
